# reuses a let-bound utility template
@config run
@theme-var example-foo 123px
@utility-def foo value: var(--example-foo);
@layer-wrap utilities
@layer-before-theme true
foo
---

      @layer utilities {
        .foo {
          value: var(--example-foo);
        }
      }

      :root, :host {
        --example-foo: 123px;
      }
